name: Mirai Daughter Musuemon
original_name: 未来ドーター ムスえもん
source:
There are four stories about main character's daughters coming from future to live and laugh with him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作包含四個故事，講述主角來自未來的女兒們來到他身邊，與他共同生活、過著笑聲不斷的日子。
